optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Plant Logistics Coordinator, Chemical Distribution Depot
professionalSummary: Planned daily loading schedules for fourteen depot slots, aligning transport contractor bookings with warehouse picking capacity.
Checked dangerous‑goods paperwork and driver authorisation for each outbound consignment before release.
Recorded depot manager release decisions and maintained current stock movement records.
Coordinated slot changes with transport contractors and documented responsibility boundaries.
Wrote daily shift exception logs detailing held consignments, paperwork rejections and hand‑over conditions.
experienceHighlights: Planned daily loading schedule for fourteen slots over two and a half years, fitting contractor bookings and warehouse capacity.
Checked every outbound consignment for dangerous‑goods paperwork and driver authorisation against the depot checklist before release.
Recorded manager release decisions in the movement system and kept stock movement records current.
Coordinated slot changes with three transport contractors by phone and in the slot log, recording agreed changes and those requiring manager approval.
Wrote shift exception log each day, listing held consignments, paperwork rejections and hand‑over conditions for the next shift.
projectsAndWorkSamples: Work sample: one week’s loading schedules, consignment checklist with release records for one day and shift exception log for the same week, with movement system references as a verification trail.
